prompt: Dark ambient dungeon exploration music for a 1990s first-person fantasy game, for crypts and catacombs. Very slow, around 60 BPM, in a minor mode. A low organ drone and deep sustained cellos, a lonely wooden flute melody that wanders and pauses, sparse glockenspiel notes like water dripping, a distant low choir pad. Sounds like a General MIDI orchestral soundtrack played through a 1990s sound card wavetable: slightly synthetic, clean, no modern cinematic bombast. Steady and unobtrusive so it can play under gameplay, keeping one even texture all the way through: no intro, no big build, no ending or fade-out, as it will loop for as long as the player explores.
